sentences.en: The closing of school was due to the heavy snow.
sentences.zh: 学校关闭是因为下雪很严重。

sentences.en: The heavy rain compelled us to put off our departure.
sentences.zh: 大雨迫使我们推迟出发。

sentences.en: He could not go out because of the heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 因为下雨很大，他不能出去。

senses.zh: 沉重的；繁重的，巨大的；拥挤的
